question: Can genuinely trained conventional Bayesian, recurrent and model-based RL controllers acquire the partial three-stage law using ONLY charged public interventions, retain knowledge across four contextual episodes, and transfer to structurally unfamiliar law families? Does MD34 leave a meaningful decision-quality gap after the strongest admissible control?

permitted_changes: derived G29 code-atlas files in a separate source-pinned qualification-only commit
scope.forbidden: No edits to MD29-MD34 frozen source/fixtures/thresholds/outcomes, original registered datasets, native Yggdrasil weights, main, accepted refs, controller, runner, scheduler, autonomous loop, other models/projects or deployment.
scope.first_use: THIS COMMIT AUTHORIZES NO EXPERIMENT EXECUTION. Prospective synthetic data training, transfer/cold first-use, workflow dispatch and owner acceptance each require source and authority checks; official/registered first-use requires separate explicit owner authorization.
scope.promotion: No SCIENTIFIC_PASS or native integration may be inferred from MD35 control performance.
scope.isolation: Standalone external research-only branch stacked on MD34; no scheduled tasks or cross-project wiring.

immutable_task.physics: Import only frozen MD34 PartialRouteWorld for charged public step(), observe() and receipt() from a harness; never change physical rules or use MD34 fixture_spec() for science cohorts.
immutable_task.law_contract: Harness may reconstruct six existing MD34 law families exactly from frozen prereg; public policies/trainers MUST NOT import or access LAWS, hidden E/G/D, family, graph, seed, offset, rewire or counterfactual outcomes.
immutable_task.each_episode: Three irreversible causal steps (precursor actuator, route decision, four-choice terminal), at most one 0.09-reward diagnostic returning a single bit; obey frozen route0/route1 costs and terminal reward.
immutable_task.block: Four episodes share a hidden law and stable/rewire condition; public context visits 0,1,2,3 in order; trainer sees only publicly announced block boundary, not hidden identities.

reserved_cohorts_not_opened.preuse_collision_check: Before any cohort generation, query authoritative consumed, reserved and official first-use ledgers for ALL four exact ranges; on collision FAIL CLOSED and make a NEW preregistration without inspecting outcomes.
reserved_cohorts_not_opened.per_cohort_formula: block=(seed-first)//4; context=(seed-first)%4; family=families[block%3]; offset=(block//3)%4; rewire=((block//12)%2)==1. Harness computes private law. No policy sees seed/block/family/offset/rewire.
reserved_cohorts_not_opened.seeding: Training and model initializations disjoint from cohort identifiers. All splits and model selection frozen before any unfamiliar transfer/cold evaluation.
reserved_cohorts_not_opened.restriction: Never reuse fixture 15000..15095 or MD33 11000..14095 or protected official/registered MD29-MD34 cohorts.

shared_physical_training.demonstration: Use a single replayable deterministic exploratory controller for ALL controls, acting only through real MD34 observe/step and actual terminal rewards. Rotate paid diagnostic phase across episodes within each law block (encoder, route0, route1, terminal) and vary route choice and terminal guesses by public context and a preregistered independent exploration seed; no oracle or law-based actions.
shared_physical_training.equality: Models train from identical public charged-action/reward transcripts in chronological order; no privately generated counterfactual labels, hallucinated observations, free probe, hidden-law teacher, or external model data.
shared_physical_training.heldout: Evaluation policies choose their own legal interventions; every probe/action is recorded with physical reward and charged to utility. No adapting weights on transfer/cold; within-block updating of a persistent scratch memory from actual public observations and terminal rewards is permitted equally.
shared_physical_training.memory: Global fit/checkpoint persists from training only; within-block state resets at declared block boundaries. Cold evaluation starts from independently restored training checkpoint and blank episodic state.

mandatory_controls.blind: No diagnostic, fixed legal route and terminal action; frozen MD34 public_blind reference.
mandatory_controls.paid_one_bit: One terminal-parity probe then legal terminal guess; frozen MD34 public_parity_only reference.
mandatory_controls.privileged_oracle: Task ceiling only; excluded from model training, policy selection and legal comparison.
mandatory_controls.bayesian: Train a genuine factorized, smoothing-calibrated Bayesian/Dirichlet latent transition belief on shared paid episodes. Maintain posterior over publicly identifiable encoder/route/decoder response hypotheses and possible change, marginalizing hidden state; maximum 4096 particles or exact collapsed posterior. Update only with observed charged physical outcomes. Precommit prior alpha=1, deterministic particle seed=35031 and selection rule maximizing expected net reward minus real diagnostic/route charges.
mandatory_controls.recurrent: Train a 64-hidden-unit gated recurrent world model on full four-episode sequences of public action, one-bit diagnostic, reward and phase observations, using Adam lr=0.001, batch=16 blocks, at most 120 epochs, minimum 20, patience 20 on independent source-family validation only, clip norm 1, weight decay 0.0001, and fixed initialization/training seeds [35035,35036,35037]. All three seeds are reported; frozen validation chooses a single checkpoint prior to heldout. Terminal/route policy maximizes expected net utility under learned predictive distribution; no privileged teacher.
mandatory_controls.model_based_rl: Train an empirical history-conditioned transition/reward model from the same charged sequences; estimate value of interventions with finite-horizon fitted-Q / Bellman backups from fitted public outcomes, 40 frozen backup sweeps, Dirichlet smoothing alpha=1, ensemble size=5, seed=35041. No future World.step, hidden-law lookup, free rollout, or unlabeled training examples; planned actions must be executed and charged.
negative_ablations: recurrent hidden memory reset every episode
model-based planner without retained law belief
action/outcome correspondence shuffled within training blocks only
mandatory_controls.no_posthoc_retraining: Do not change capacities, seeds, early-stopping rules, controls, losses, selection criteria or thresholds in response to evaluation results. Failure is recorded and any redesigned controls require distinct preregistration and fresh heldouts.

compute_and_fairness.caps: Same public data, maximum paid training actions and charged evaluation actions per episode; each model has a 900 CPU-second end-to-end fitting/selection budget on the same pinned single-thread CPU platform. Report actual wall/CPU for all data preparation, fitting, validation, inference, checkpointing and scoring; no uncharged external computation.
compute_and_fairness.matching: If the relevant model comparisons differ by >10% actual whole-process CPU or >10% information/actions available, no matched-compute superiority claim. Lower-compute models may still Pareto-dominate higher-compute models; report raw costs.
compute_and_fairness.software: Freeze exact source/dependency hashes before training, Python 3.12 and pinned CPU deps; never change science to repair test parity after first-use. Cross-platform numerical differences must be measured, not hidden.

metrics.primary: Mean physically net charged utility on 384 structurally unfamiliar transfer episodes AND 192 independently cold-restored episodes; higher is better.
secondaries: mean paid diagnostics and route1 fraction
false causal reuse after decoder rewire
per-control full-process CPU seconds and model sizes
metrics.uncertainty: 2000 deterministic bootstrap resamples over hidden-law blocks (not individual episodes), seed=35045; report 95% percentile bounds and all per-block receipts.
metrics.conventional_saturation: If any fully trained admissible conventional control achieves mean net utility >=0.89 (within 0.05 of the 0.94 privileged task oracle) on BOTH independent unfamiliar transfer and cold, classify TRIVIAL_FOR_NOVEL_GAIN_STOP. Do not run a new native mechanism on MD34.
metrics.underqualification: If no competent conventional control exceeds +0.10 mean utility on BOTH unfamiliar transfer and cold, classify CONTROLS_UNDERQUALIFIED_OR_UNIDENTIFIABLE_NO_NATIVE_GATE.
metrics.development_headroom: If at least one independent trained conventional control beats +0.10 on transfer and cold but none saturates, classify DEVELOPING_TASK_HEADROOM_ONLY; this is not a native Yggdrasil scientific gain and does not authorize first-use.
metrics.invalidity: Any seed ledger conflict, private information leakage, hidden-law shortcut, uncharged probe/counterfactual, invalid cold restore or failure of source/physics parity makes the study INVALID_NOT_SCIENCE.

qualification.required: Source-pinned full inherited mandatory regression on Windows 2022 and Ubuntu, all MD30–MD34 frozen tests plus MD35 tests, exact-byte public physical action and reward receipts when deterministic, separate derived G29 atlas on exact final SHA, scientific provenance and negative/ablation receipts.
qualification.controls: Tests must reject seed/graph access from policies, free environment stepping, reused consumed cohorts, model checkpoint contamination, within-heldout fitting, physical-cost omission, unreported neural seed, and perturbation of frozen MD34 physics.
qualification.evidence_destination: Repository and GitHub Actions artifacts only; do not generate chat Library evidence files.
